pn.demoSweetSourGoal.en: I love food that's both sweet and sour, but I don't want it to be too heavy on my body. What options suit me?

pn.demoFrontendGoal.en: How should a front-end system with multiple layouts and themes be designed?

pn.galaxyIncomplete.zh-Hant-TW: 星系格式不完整，請再生成一次，或貼上修正後的 JSON
pn.galaxyIncomplete.en: The galaxy is incomplete. Generate it again, or paste corrected JSON

pn.galaxyShown.zh-Hant-TW: 這是「{goal}」的星系。按 1／2／3 選方案，再按 Enter 填回對話框。
pn.galaxyShown.en: This is the galaxy for "{goal}". Press 1/2/3 to pick a plan, then Enter to fill it into the chat box.

pn.pasteTitle.zh-Hant-TW: 貼上 AI 回覆的 JSON
pn.pasteTitle.en: Paste the JSON from the AI's reply

pn.pasteBody.zh-Hant-TW: 在對話裡找到 AI 回覆的 JSON 程式碼區塊，按它的「複製」按鈕，再貼到下面。
pn.pasteBody.en: Find the JSON code block in the AI's reply, click its "Copy" button, and paste it below.

pn.pasteFailedBody.zh-Hant-TW: 貼上的內容不是完整的星系 JSON。請確認從 { 開頭複製到最後的 }。
pn.pasteFailedBody.en: The pasted content isn't a complete galaxy JSON. Make sure you copy from the opening { to the final }.

pn.cliFailedStrip.en: ⚠ The local AI didn't produce a usable galaxy

pn.useWebAi.en: Use the AI on this page instead

pn.gaveUpMsg.zh-Hant-TW: 已放棄等待。可以在輸入框打新的問題，再按 iG。
pn.gaveUpMsg.en: Stopped waiting. You can type a new question in the input box, then press iG.

pn.promptPlacedStrip.zh-Hant-TW: 📨 提示詞已放進輸入框：請按對話框的送出鍵，送出後這裡會自動接著等
pn.promptPlacedStrip.en: 📨 The prompt is in the input box: press the chat's send button, and this panel will keep waiting automatically

pn.repliedPasteJson.zh-Hant-TW: 已回覆但沒出現？貼上 JSON
pn.repliedPasteJson.en: Replied but nothing showed up? Paste JSON

pn.slowNote.zh-Hant-TW: 超過 20 秒還沒有回覆：可能選了深度推理模型（如 Pro、Thinking），常要 5–15 分鐘。可以按右上角「—」縮小面板，完成時 iG 按鈕會顯示 ✓；想快一點，下次先在網頁上切換到一般模型。
pn.slowNote.en: No reply after 20 seconds: you may have picked a deep-reasoning model (such as Pro or Thinking), which often takes 5–15 minutes. You can press "—" in the top-right corner to minimize the panel; the iG button shows ✓ when it's done. For faster results, switch to a standard model on the page next time.

pn.stillGenerating.zh-Hant-TW: ⋯ 「{goal}」仍在生成，完成時會自動換成它的星系
pn.stillGenerating.en: ⋯ "{goal}" is still generating; its galaxy will replace this one automatically when done

pn.waitingForSend.en: Waiting for you to press send…

pn.waitingForAi.zh-Hant-TW: 等待 AI 在對話中回覆星系 JSON…
pn.waitingForAi.en: Waiting for the AI to reply with the galaxy JSON in the chat…

pn.confirmChatHow.zh-Hant-TW: 我會把一段分析提示詞放進這個對話的輸入框，由你按送出；AI 回覆後自動畫出星系。對話裡的提示詞和 JSON 會自動折疊成一行，點一下可以展開。
pn.confirmChatHow.en: I'll put an analysis prompt into this chat's input box, and you press send; the galaxy is drawn automatically once the AI replies. The prompt and JSON in the chat are collapsed into a single line; click to expand.

pn.confirmChatNote.zh-Hant-TW:
⏱ 一般模型約 1–3 分鐘；推理型高階模型（如 ChatGPT Pro、Thinking、Gemini Pro）可能要 5–15 分鐘，想快一點可以先在網頁上切換到一般模型。
不想讓提示詞出現在對話裡？在終端機執行 {cmd}，改用本機的 AI 生成。
pn.confirmChatNote.en:
⏱ Standard models take about 1–3 minutes; advanced reasoning models (such as ChatGPT Pro, Thinking, Gemini Pro) may take 5–15 minutes. For faster results, switch to a standard model on the page first.
Don't want the prompt to appear in the chat? Run {cmd} in a terminal to generate with your local AI instead.

pn.doneStrip.en: This is the galaxy already generated for this chat

pn.localDoneStrip.zh-Hant-TW: 這是本機已生成的星系
pn.localDoneStrip.en: This is the galaxy already generated locally

pn.useLocalAi.zh-Hant-TW: 改用本機 AI（不進對話，但看不到前文）
pn.useLocalAi.en: Use local AI instead (stays out of the chat, but can't see earlier messages)

pn.cliBusyMsg.zh-Hant-TW: 本機正在生成上一個問題；完成後會問你要不要換成輸入框的新問題。
pn.cliBusyMsg.en: The local AI is still generating the previous question; when it's done, you'll be asked whether to switch to the new question in the input box.

pn.introTitle.en: First, write down what you need to decide

pn.introBody.zh-Hant-TW:
在這個網頁的輸入框打一句你正在猶豫的事（例如「如何挑選洗碗機？」），再點 iG 或按 Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+G。
星系會把它拆成 4 種角度的 12 個觀點和 3 條方案，你選好後，方案會填回輸入框讓 AI 照著回答。
pn.introBody.en:
Type one sentence about something you're undecided on into this page's input box (for example, "How do I choose a dishwasher?"), then click iG or press Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+G.
The galaxy breaks it into 12 viewpoints from 4 angles and 3 plans; once you pick one, the plan is filled back into the input box for the AI to follow.

pn.newQuestionTitle.en: There's a new question in the input box

pn.newQuestionBody.zh-Hant-TW:
「{text}」

要用它重新生成星系，還是留在目前這個星系？
pn.newQuestionBody.en:
"{text}"

Generate a new galaxy from it, or stay on the current galaxy?

pn.stillWaitingTitle.zh-Hant-TW: 上一個問題還在等 AI 回覆
pn.stillWaitingTitle.en: The previous question is still waiting for the AI's reply

pn.stillWaitingBody.zh-Hant-TW:
正在等：{goal}
AI 回完之前，網站通常不接受新訊息。要繼續等，還是放棄它、改問新的問題？
pn.stillWaitingBody.en:
Waiting on: {goal}
Sites usually don't accept new messages until the AI finishes replying. Keep waiting, or give it up and ask the new question?

pn.giveUpAskNew.en: Give up and ask the new question

pn.cancelledElsewhere.zh-Hant-TW: 這個生成已在其他分頁取消。可以在輸入框打問題，再按 iG。
pn.cancelledElsewhere.en: This generation was cancelled in another tab. You can type a question in the input box, then press iG.

pn.promptPreamble.en: (This is an Intent Galaxy analysis prompt. Just press send. The AI will first lay out viewpoints from different angles and 3 plans instead of answering the question directly.)
